sentences.text:
1. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. Application is allowed, subject to all just exceptions.

1. This petition has been filed for quashing of the FIR No. 276/2019 under Sections 498A/406/354/34 IPC registered at PS Prem Nagar, Rohini District, Delhi on the grounds of settlement between the parties dated 09th September, 2021.
Respondent No.2 (complainant) is not present in Court and her counsel states that she will be available on the next date of hearing.
2. Petitioner No.1 is present in Court and he will also be present on the next date of hearing.
3. Petitioners 2-7 who are family members of petitioner No.1 are exempted from appearance in the Court on an oral request of learned counsel for the petitioner.
This is a digitally signed order.
